name: apple-notes
title: Apple Notes clone
description: Apple Notes for your Markdown files, with the Docstream rich editor. Add multiple folders under On My Mac; their handles are remembered across reloads. Each sidebar location is its own master list in a NavigationStack: folders push, file leaves open the note. The top-right control switches to the library's file Tree. Right-click any folder, note or location to rename, duplicate or delete it in place. The filter shows All Files or one type (Markdown, 3D models, images, JSON & YAML, spreadsheets, code & text); an STL model opens in a 3D viewer, an image in an image viewer, JSON or YAML in visual-json or as code (JSON edits save back to the file), a CSV or TSV in the library's GPU-sorted Spreadsheet, and source and text files in a code editor highlighted by gpu-lexer. Spreadsheet and code edits autosave (⌘S saves at once), and a file changed outside Notes reloads, or asks which copy to keep when you have edits. Embeds load from the note's folder, "Choose file…" picks any file in it, and dragging rows (or files from your computer) onto a note embeds them; drop computer files on a folder to copy them in, or drag files onto another location to move or copy them. Includes OPFS personal notes, autosave, native document properties, task state icons and menus, folder-backed live examples, unseen external-edit blue dots and conflict recovery. Starts with no sample content. Responsive SplitView on desktop, tablet and phone.
